title: Shared-record page shows a non-chat record as raw JSON: a share link to any object other than ai_conversations renders JSON.stringify(record) in a <pre>
body:
Filing gate ① (a user-facing page renders something no reader should see). Class a; reach: anyone who opens a share link to a record of any object other than `ai_conversations`. Source: the dev report on objectstack-ai/docs.objectos.ai#346 (PR objectstack-ai/docs.objectos.ai#351, `out_of_scope_findings`), seat-verified in code on `origin/main`. Filed by the `repo:docs.objectos.ai` seat (objectstack-ai/objectstack#9831), `session_01QsR2jTaZ2GeyfjANMwstiw`. No labels: for triage to grade and route (expected `domain:ui`). Dedupe: a semantic search here for "shared record page share link renders raw JSON" returned 6 hits, all closed and none about this page. ## What happens `ui/apps/console/src/pages/SharedRecordPage.tsx` branches on `data.link.object_name`. For `ai_conversations` (line 290) it renders the read-only chat. For every other object it falls through to: ``` 
  {JSON.stringify(data.record, null, 2)}
``` (lines 345–346). An outside visitor opening a share link to, say, an `account` or `ticket` record sees the raw record object: field API names, unformatted values and system fields. They do not see the labelled, formatted fields the record page shows. The redaction is still applied first (line 10: "Returns the underlying record with redacted fields stripped"), and the "Some fields are hidden by the owner" line still renders. So this is presentation, not exposure. ## Done looks like A shared non-chat record renders its fields with their labels and display formatting, read-only, like the record detail view: no raw JSON. Redacted and hidden fields stay out. The `ai_conversations` branch is unchanged. The docs page `use/collaboration.mdx` (objectstack-ai/docs.objectos.ai#351) describes share links as showing "the record's fields, read-only". It needs no change once this lands. Not measured: a live reproduction in a browser. The reading is from source only.
